73: func sanitizeSessionID(id string) (string, error) {
74: 	clean := strings.TrimSpace(id)
75: 	if clean == "" {
76: 		return "", errors.New("empty session id")
77: 	}
78: 	for i := 0; i < len(clean); i++ {
79: 		c := clean[i]
80: 		if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '_' || c == '-' {
81: 			continue
82: 		}
83: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid character '%c' in session id %q", c, clean)
84: 	}
85: 	return clean, nil
86: }

88: func buildQuotedIDList(threadIDs []string) (string, error) {
89: 	if len(threadIDs) == 0 {
90: 		return "", errors.New("empty thread id list")
91: 	}
92: 	var b strings.Builder
93: 	for i, id := range threadIDs {

95: 		if err != nil {
96: 			return "", err

100: 		}
101: 		b.WriteByte('\'')
102: 		b.WriteString(clean)
103: 		b.WriteByte('\'')
104: 	}
105: 	return b.String(), nil
106: }

124: 		if err := rows.Scan(&cid, &name, &ctype, &notnull, &dflt, &pk); err == nil {

126: 				return true
